hypothesis: Narrower widths in the unchanged four-cubic Newton construction lower complete inverse-square-root cost.
parameter_ranges: Exactly the reference control and two named width tuples in delta, coef, square, product, result order.
correctness_conditions: Strictly positive full-domain model margin, no more than 90 percent worst relative tolerance, exact native model phase, input restored and scratch cleared.
objective: Minimize complete modeled official QC with measured native counts and exhaustive model margins.
stop_rule: Stop on reference mismatch or shared budget violation. Retain rejected lanes and select only among passing candidates.

development.extra_inputs: Include the two domain endpoints, ±1 around 2^k and 3*2^k within the domain, and the lane's minimum-margin and worst-relative-error input.

selection: Lowest complete modeled QC, then largest minimum absolute margin, then name.

promotion.confirmation: Full domain and official shots per input with a fresh independently generated salt, registered against the frozen hash before execution.
